in_marathi.name: Vikashkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikashkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vikas means progress or development, and Kumar is a suffix indicating a young boy. So, Vikashkumar can be interpreted as 'One who brings development and growth in young age'.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Vikashkumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Vikas means progress or development, and Kumar is a suffix indicating a young boy. So, Vikashkumar can be interpreted as 'One who brings development and growth in young age'.
